samples.profile: Godot game using GDScript and scene metadata

metrics.executionSuccess: exit code is zero and a readable artifact is produced
metrics.fileCoverage: distinct primary-language files represented / primary-language files on disk
metrics.symbolRecall: matched declared symbol truths / declared symbol truths
metrics.callRecall: matched declared call truths / declared call truths
metrics.locationPrecision: matched truths with a file and compatible line location / matched truths
metrics.danglingRelationRate: relations whose source or target cannot be resolved / all relations
metrics.duplicateFactRate: provider facts sharing one provider-neutral identity / all imported facts
metrics.providerOverlap: facts independently emitted by both providers / union of provider-neutral facts
metrics.providerConflictRate: same identity and fact kind with incompatible values / union of provider-neutral facts
metrics.incrementalScope: files reported or reprocessed after one controlled source edit
metrics.runtimeSeconds: wall-clock seconds measured by the same local machine
metrics.artifactBytes: bytes of persisted provider output excluding dependency installations

matchingRules.paths: repository-relative POSIX paths; exact match after removing a leading ./
matchingRules.symbols: case-sensitive name and exact file; line must fall within the emitted source range when a range exists
matchingRules.calls: case-sensitive caller and callee terminal names in the declared caller file; an emitted source line is checked when available
matchingRules.unknown: absence, parser rejection, dynamic ambiguity, or unsupported syntax is recorded as unknown or unsupported, never inferred as success

interpretation.reason: Different foundation risks are not interchangeable; report the metric vector and hard capability gaps.
gates: Artifacts must preserve provider identity and source evidence.
An unsupported required language is a capability gap, not a zero-node success.
A combined import must not overwrite disagreements between providers.
No provider schema may become the Code Synapse canonical schema.
